**7 / 7** invariants in this zone have at least one covering test (**7** verified in the per-PR gate; the rest run nightly — _(nightly)_ below).

| ID | Invariant | Covered by |
|----|-----------|------------|
| INV-TAGS-01 | A Tag name is unique within a household, **case-insensitively**, on both create and rename — the `tags_household_name_live` partial unique index over `(household_id, lower(name))` raises 23505, surfaced as `ErrTagNameExists` from `CreateTag` and `UpdateTag` alike. The index is `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`, so a soft-deleted Tag's name is freed for reuse and never collides with a live one | `backend/internal/repo/tags_tenancy_test.go` |
| INV-TAGS-02 | `DeleteTag` detaches, never orphans: in **one transaction** it soft-deletes the Tag (`SoftDeleteTag`) and clears `tag_id` across all four position groups (`ClearAssetTag`/`ClearLiabilityTag`/`ClearReceivableTag`/`ClearInvestmentTag`), so no Position is left pointing at a dead Tag — each falls back to the Untagged bucket. A zero-row soft-delete (missing or cross-tenant id) returns `ErrNotFound` before any clear runs; any step's failure rolls the whole transaction back | `backend/internal/repo/tags_tenancy_test.go` |
| INV-TAGS-03 | `assignTag` (the one assignment path behind `AssignTag` and every position create/update) sets, reassigns, or clears (nil `tagID`) a Position's Tag and validates household ownership of **both** sides in SQL: a non-nil Tag is looked up by `GetTagByID` under the caller's `household_id` first (a cross-household, soft-deleted or missing Tag is `ErrNotFound`, with no write), and the per-group UPDATE filters the Position by `household_id` too (zero rows affected — cross-household or unknown Position — is `ErrNotFound`). An invalid `TagGroup` is `ErrNotFound`. No path produces a silent cross-tenant link | `backend/internal/repo/tags_tenancy_test.go` |
| INV-TAGS-04 | `TagBreakdown` is INV-FINANCE-01 cut by Tag: per `(tag_id, grp, currency)` it sums each contributing Position's most-recent snapshot (`year_month <= current month`, active or terminated in/after the current month — the net-worth carry-forward rule), with `tag_id` NULL as the Untagged bucket. The union of every Tag's cells plus the Untagged bucket reconciles to the household's net-worth components; the result is household-scoped (another household sees none of these rows) | `backend/internal/repo/tags_tenancy_test.go` |
| INV-TAGS-05 | The client fold `aggregateTagBreakdown` (the report's presentation layer over the flat breakdown rows) sums holdings as asset + receivable + investment, keeps liabilities as a separate positive magnitude (`net = holdings − liabilities`), routes null `tag_id` into an Untagged cell with the muted colour, sorts cells holdings-desc with Untagged always last, splits currencies into their own breakdowns ordered by code, and defensively drops non-finite totals | `frontend/src/lib/tagBreakdown.test.ts` |
| INV-TAGS-06 | `AssignTagBatch` (Tags page, #853) sets or clears (nil) one Tag on many Positions across all four groups in **one transaction**, so ADR-0028's one-Tag-per-Position holds by construction (a batch *moves* an item off its old Tag). It is all-or-nothing and tenant-safe: a non-nil Tag must be this household's, each group's UPDATE filters by `household_id`, and any group whose affected-row count differs from the distinct ids sent (unknown, deleted or cross-household id) rolls the whole batch back as `ErrNotFound`. `ListTaggableItems` is household-scoped and lists a Position with no snapshot (nil value) so it can be tagged first | `backend/internal/repo/tags_batch_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/tags/TagItemsPanel.test.tsx` |
| INV-TAGS-07 | A Position's Tag is written by its own create/update, in the **same transaction** as the position write (#839): every subtype (bank account, property, vehicle, liability, receivable, stock, mutual fund, gold, bond, time deposit) accepts an optional `tag_id`. On create null/absent leaves it untagged; on update **absent leaves the Tag unchanged, `null` clears it, a uuid assigns it** (`repo.TagChange`, decoded so the handler can tell absent from null). A Tag that is not a live Tag of the caller's household is `ErrNotFound` (404, no existence leak) and rolls the whole write back — no position is created and an update's other edits do not land; a malformed uuid is a 400. There is no single-item assignment route: the only dedicated route is the bulk `PUT /api/tags/assignments` (INV-TAGS-06) | `backend/internal/assets/position_tag_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/investments/position_tag_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/liabilities/position_tag_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/receivables/position_tag_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/position_tag_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/PositionTag.test.tsx` |
